desc: The Franklin Armory M4 Built Lower Receiver is made of forged 7075-T6 aluminum and finished with anodized black type III hard coat. A specialized tension screw eliminates upper/lower play resulting in highly stable build. The lower receiver contains a standard milspec trigger and an A2 pistol grip. Rounding out this complete lower is a reinforced M4 design six position collapsible stock mounted on an aluminum carbine length receiver extension. Multiple rear sling mounting points and an angled heel for easy transitions round out this high quality foundation for any AR-15 build.
